en: Illustrated postcard showing two men in traditional-style clothing with caps, wide trousers and clogs walking in the foreground. Behind them is a stylized night-time cityscape with gabled houses and a tall church tower, lit streetlamps, a couple walking in the distance, and a large anthropomorphized moon with a face in the dark sky. The word "Nijmegen" is printed below the scene. Along the left edge appears the publisher's imprint and a small logo with a number at the bottom left.
